record: One website / operator or property, matched by URL. An operator may represent multiple rentals.

fields.id: Stable identifier: ME-0001 etc. Existing entries use LAZY-<slug>.
fields.name: Property or operator name
fields.recordType: Property, Property / small operator, Rental operator, or Demo property
fields.demo: True for the existing demo websites; they are not independently verified real rental listings
fields.featured: True for the LAZY demos: Featured label, coral card border and coral map pin
fields.sourceFacts: Allowlisted public demo facts, source URL, research date and notes
fields.type: House, Cabin, Camp, Apartment, or Unknown
fields.guests: Unambiguous numeric capacity or Unknown; do not infer from beds or a collection of properties
fields.capacityDetails: Original capacity wording, including unit variations
fields.priceFrom: Unambiguous numeric nightly price or Unknown
fields.priceDetails: Published rates and qualifications; may be historical or date-specific
fields.town: Town or area used for coarse geocoding, or Unknown
fields.lat: Numeric town / area latitude, or Unknown
fields.lng: Numeric town / area longitude, or Unknown
fields.locationPrecision: Town / area approximate, or Unknown; never claims a street-address pin
fields.locationSource: Town coordinate lookup URL or Unknown
fields.photo: Optimized 560x350 card cover path, or Unknown
fields.coverPhoto: Original selected cover path, or Unknown
fields.photos: Array of selected property photos, each with file and role; excludes logos
fields.logo: Separate optional company logo path, or Unknown
fields.photoStatus: Complete, Partial, No property photos, or Website mismatch
fields.address: Published address components, type, status, sourceUrl, checkedOn and notes. Missing components are Unknown. Read the type: offices, PO boxes and arrival points are not house locations.
fields.sourceDetails: Unmodified original CSV fields and verification notes
fields.source: Import source: list, form, found or lazy
fields.checked: Last available website check date or Unknown; import itself is not a live website check
fields.listingStatus: Active or Needs review; Needs review entries stay in the database but out of recommendations
fields.descriptionSource: Public source URL for the collected description, or Unknown
fields.descriptionStatus: Collected from source website or Not collected
fields.collectionStatus: Complete, Incomplete or Needs review; independent of website health and publication
fields.missingRequiredFields: Explicit shortages. Complete requires a physical Maine property/business address verified on the official site, four property photographs and a source description. PO boxes, arrival points and out-of-state contacts do not satisfy physical address completeness.
fields.cardDescription: Source-based card summary, at most 150 characters
fields.cardDescriptionSource: Official source URL supporting the card summary
fields.cardPhotos: Three saved photographs for cards mode, with stable ID and provenance in data/sources/cards
fields.cardPhotoLabel: Optional named rental or campus identifying an operator card photo set
fields.platformLinks: Verified attributable outgoing Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com URLs; badges are not clickable
fields.listingReview: Reason, observed destination and check date for a held record
